fs-sh-order.back: Bed first, roof second. The ground pulls heat by conduction all night.
fs-sh-order.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="The ground steals the most heat when you lie on it: a person on bare ground loses heat straight down; a person on a thick bed of boughs or a pad keeps it. Insulate under you first, then over you.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">The ground steals the most heat</text><rect x="0" y="200" width="400" height="100" rx="0" fill="#dfe6d3"/><rect x="106" y="185" width="55" height="15" rx="5.5" fill="#e8590c"/><line x1="161" y1="193" x2="201" y2="194" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="8.8" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="95" cy="190" r="9.9" fill="#d9b48f"/><line x1="100" y1="204" x2="100" y2="240" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="100,250 106,240 94,240" fill="#4a7fb0"/><line x1="130" y1="204" x2="130" y2="240" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="130,250 136,240 124,240" fill="#4a7fb0"/><line x1="160" y1="204" x2="160" y2="240" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="160,250 166,240 154,240" fill="#4a7fb0"/><line x1="190" y1="204" x2="190" y2="240" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="190,250 196,240 184,240" fill="#4a7fb0"/><text x="150" y="280" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="middle">On bare ground</text><rect x="240" y="186" width="140" height="14" rx="4" fill="#8a9a6b"/><rect x="284" y="173" width="45" height="13" rx="4.5" fill="#e8590c"/><line x1="329" y1="181" x2="361" y2="182" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="7.2" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="275" cy="178" r="8.1" fill="#d9b48f"/><text x="310" y="230" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d32" text-anchor="middle">Thick bed under</text><text x="310" y="250" font-size="15" fill="#2e7d32" text-anchor="middle">heat stays in</text><text x="200" y="60" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Insulate under you first</text><text x="200" y="82" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">then over you</text>
</svg>

fs-sh-when.back: At least an hour before dark, when the light turns gold and you are still far from the truck.

fs-sh-site.front: Best spot for a night out?
fs-sh-site.back: A sheltered bench part way up, near trees, fuel and an opening. Not the valley bottom, not the windy top.
fs-sh-site.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Pick the spot: a sheltered bench part way up the slope, near trees and firewood, is best. Avoid the valley bottom where cold air pools, the windy ridge top, and anything under a dead tree that can fall.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Pick the spot</text><path d="M0 230 L120 150 L200 175 L290 120 L400 160 L400 300 L0 300 Z" fill="#dfe6d3"/><path d="M200 175 L200 300" fill="none" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/><text x="200" y="290" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4a7fb0" text-anchor="middle">cold air pools low</text><rect x="57" y="182" width="6" height="14" rx="0" fill="#8b5a2b"/><polygon points="60,126 44,182 76,182" fill="#8a9a6b"/><rect x="97" y="160" width="6" height="12" rx="0" fill="#8b5a2b"/><polygon points="100,112 86,160 114,160" fill="#8a9a6b"/><line x1="330" y1="136" x2="330" y2="70" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="330" y1="80" x2="350" y2="66" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="352" y1="54" x2="368" y2="70" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="368" y1="54" x2="352" y2="70" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="330" y="56" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="end">dead tree</text><circle cx="150" cy="164" r="9.0" fill="#2e7d32"/><path d="M138 140 l10 10 l17 -19" fill="none" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="6.0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="130" y="80" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d32" text-anchor="middle">Bench part way up</text><text x="130" y="98" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">near trees and fuel</text><text x="290" y="108" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">windy top</text>
</svg>

fs-sh-cold-air.front: Why not sleep in the valley bottom?
fs-sh-cold-air.back: Cold air sinks and pools there at night, and it is often wet.

fs-sh-lookup.back: Up: no dead trees or hanging branches over you.

fs-sh-bed.back: Foam pad, pack, boughs, dry grass or leaves, thick enough to stay a hand thick when you lie on it.

fs-sh-tarp.back: Tight cord between trees, drape the tarp, pin the windward edge low, bed underneath.
fs-sh-tarp.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Tarp step 3: pull the windward edge down to the ground and pin it with rocks or stakes. Open side away from the wind.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">3. Low to the wind</text><rect x="0" y="230" width="400" height="70" rx="0" fill="#dfe6d3"/><rect x="57" y="198" width="6" height="32" rx="0" fill="#8b5a2b"/><polygon points="60,70 24,198 96,198" fill="#8a9a6b"/><rect x="337" y="198" width="6" height="32" rx="0" fill="#8b5a2b"/><polygon points="340,70 304,198 376,198" fill="#8a9a6b"/><polygon points="110,150 290,150 330,230 70,230" fill="#4f7a52"/><line x1="390" y1="120" x2="330" y2="154" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="320,160 334,160 327,148" fill="#4a7fb0"/><text x="370" y="100" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#4a7fb0" text-anchor="middle">wind</text><circle cx="80" cy="230" r="8.0" fill="#9a9a8f"/><circle cx="320" cy="230" r="8.0" fill="#9a9a8f"/><text x="200" y="288" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Windward edge pinned low</text>
</svg>

fs-sh-wind.front: Which side of the tarp faces the wind?
fs-sh-wind.back: The low pinned edge. The open side faces away.

fs-sh-foil.front: What is a foil blanket bad at?
fs-sh-foil.back: Stopping heat loss into the ground. It also tears and traps moisture.

fs-sh-bivy.back: Bivy bag in the pack (wraps you, stops wind); foil blanket as pocket backup. Both need a bed under.

fs-sh-debris.back: Pole from a stump to the ground, close ribs, pile debris thick, fill the inside, plug the door.
fs-sh-debris.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Debris hut step 3: pile leaves, needles and boughs thick over the ribs. Thicker is warmer.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">3. Pile it thick</text><rect x="0" y="230" width="400" height="70" rx="0" fill="#dfe6d3"/><path d="M60 230 Q70 150 200 170 Q330 190 350 230 Z" fill="#9a7b4f"/><text x="200" y="120" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Thick as your arm is long</text><text x="200" y="140" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">(Tip)</text><text x="200" y="288" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Pile it thick</text>
</svg>

fs-sh-debris-con.back: It takes hours and lots of dry material. A tarp is faster.

fs-sh-reflector.front: How does a reflector wall help?
fs-sh-reflector.back: Logs or rocks behind a small fire bounce heat back toward you.
fs-sh-reflector.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Fire plus a reflector wall: a wall of stacked logs behind the fire bounces heat back toward the person lying on a bed on the other side. Keep the fire small with a safe gap, and check the fire rules.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Fire plus reflector wall</text><rect x="0" y="220" width="400" height="80" rx="0" fill="#dfe6d3"/><rect x="290" y="140" width="24" height="80" rx="4" fill="#8b5a2b"/><rect x="318" y="140" width="24" height="80" rx="4" fill="#8b5a2b"/><text x="316" y="128" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Log wall</text><line x1="214" y1="214" x2="262" y2="206" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="9.0" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="218" y1="206" x2="266" y2="214" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="9.0" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M226 206 Q221 182 240 161 Q259 182 254 206 Z" fill="#e8590c"/><path d="M233 206 Q230 193 240 180 Q250 193 247 206 Z" fill="#f6c344"/><rect x="40" y="204" width="120" height="14" rx="4" fill="#8a9a6b"/><rect x="78" y="193" width="40" height="11" rx="4.0" fill="#e8590c"/><line x1="118" y1="199" x2="147" y2="200" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="6.4" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="70" cy="197" r="7.2" fill="#d9b48f"/><line x1="250" y1="160" x2="168" y2="178" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="160,180 169,183 167,174" fill="#e8590c"/><line x1="280" y1="180" x2="178" y2="195" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="170,196 179,200 177,190" fill="#e8590c"/><text x="140" y="120" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">Heat bounces back</text><text x="200" y="288" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Small fire, safe gap, check the rules</text>
</svg>

fs-sh-co.front: Fire or stove inside a closed shelter?
fs-sh-co.back: Never. Carbon monoxide and fire risk.

fs-sh-night.back: Eat, pee, dry socks on, toque on all night, boots in a bag. Cold: eat and move.
fs-sh-night.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Night routine for an unplanned night: eat before sleep, pee before sleep, put on dry socks and dry wet ones inside your shirt, keep the toque on all night, keep boots in a bag so they do not freeze, and when cold, clench muscles, eat and move.">

  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Night routine</text><rect x="20" y="46" width="112" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2f3a2b" sleep</text><rect x="145" y="46" width="112" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="201" y="86" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Pee</text><text x="201" y="110" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">before sleep</text><rect x="270" y="46" width="112" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="326" y="86" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Dry socks</text><text x="326" y="110" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">wet in shirt</text><rect x="20" y="150" width="112" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="76" y="190" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Toque on</text><text x="76" y="214" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">all night</text><rect x="145" y="150" width="112" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="201" y="190" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Boots</text><text x="201" y="214" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">in a bag, not out</text><rect x="270" y="150" width="112" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="326" y="190" font-size="17" fs-sh-buddy.back: One bed, one cover, back to back. Colder or hurt person in the middle of the insulation.
fs-sh-buddy.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Two hunters share heat: lie back to back on one bed under one cover. Two bodies, one roof.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Two hunters: share heat</text><rect x="0" y="220" width="400" height="80" rx="0" fill="#dfe6d3"/><rect x="80" y="206" width="240" height="14" rx="4" fill="#8a9a6b"/><rect x="110" y="186" width="80" height="20" rx="6" fill="#e8590c"/><circle cx="100" cy="194" r="9.0" fill="#d9b48f"/><rect x="200" y="186" width="80" height="20" rx="6" fill="#7c5a99"/><circle cx="290" cy="194" r="9.0" fill="#d9b48f"/><path d="M90 182 Q200 120 310 182" fill="none" stroke="#4f7a52" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="200" y="100" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Back to back, one bed</text><text x="200" y="120" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">one cover over both</text><text x="200" y="285" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Two bodies, one roof</text>
</svg>

fs-sh-visible.front: Shelter hidden in thick timber. Problem?
fs-sh-visible.back: Searchers cannot see you. Put orange and bright gear in the nearest opening.
